paragraphs.text: Svogthos is the Guildhall of the Golgari in the Undercity of Ravnica .

Svogthos is a massive former Orzhov cathedral with a huge amphitheater and towering columns, so ancient that even the Erstwhile no longer recall its origins. It currently stands at the center of Korozda , the Maze of Decay, an immense circular maze of fungal hedgerows and overgrown, moss-encrusted ruins.

The arched subterranean structure of Svogthos is elaborately decorated and gilded, a sign that it used to be a cathedral of the Orzhov Syndicate . Denizens of Above would whisper of how the cathedral was beautiful, once. Its curved arches and stony towers glistened with obsidian and silver in days gone by. But the wear of centuries left it cold and damp, heavy with the smell of staleness and soil. Svogthos is a semi-living structure in which the detached, severed head of Svogthir is housed and is claimed to move as the center of Golgari territory shifts.

Inside Svogthos is a cavernous chamber, known as the Statuary . A raised stone causeway runs through its center, with statues lining either side. Except the statues aren't truly statues, they are Vraska 's victims.

Svogthos was where the Golgari parun Svogthir was entombed until he was raised back into unlife by Savra vod Savo . After attempting to betray her, Svogthir was disintegrated, leaving only his polished skull, which Savra attached to her scepter. Savra then took over as guildmaster , reigning from the throne of Svogthos for a brief time until her death during the Decamillennial , the role as guildmaster passing to her brother, Jarad vod Savo .

Jarad and his Devkarin had preferred the psychotropic delights of the rot gardens and left Svogthos to decay and crumble for over 60 years. However, upon the death of Jarad, Vraska moved the Golgari court back into Svogthos and built a throne out of her petrified opponents.

During the War of the Spark , Ral Zarek , Kaya Cassir , Teyo Verada , and Araithia Shokta were allowed through Korozda and brought into Svogthos by the lich Storrev . Seeking the aid of the Golgari against the invading Dreadhorde , they were met by Cevraya , Azdomas , Varolz , and Izoni holding court in place of the recently deceased Mazirek . They were interrupted in their discussion by the return of Vraska, coming back from her refuge in High and Dry on the plane of Ixalan . After assessing the situation, Vraska agreed to have the Golgari join the defense of the plane against Nicol Bolas .
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Realmbreaker cracked the cathedral walls of Svogthos on command of the compleated Vraska.
